identity.name: James 'Peck' Curtis
identity.summary: Drummer in the original King Biscuit Time band on KFFA in Helena, Arkansas, with Sonny Boy Williamson II and Pinetop Perkins.

contribution.description: Played drums in the original band of King Biscuit Time, the longest-running daily American radio show, bringing a drummer to Delta blues on the air; Levon Helm credited him in particular for inspiring his career.
